methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents non-metro institution building deep capability outside traditional tech hubs, creating potential for distributed AI fluency through leadership development and peer learning networks in smaller cities.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community-led AI workshops targeting the 'technology gap' signal grassroots capability building in Hampton Roads, demonstrating distributed peer learning that could enable deep fluency beyond metro concentration zones.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Opinion piece explicitly frames data center concentration as deepening urban-rural divide, signaling infrastructure that benefits NoVA economically while neither distributing capability nor building deep AI literacy in underserved regions.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU partnership with AI Ready RVA concentrates educational and innovation resources in the Richmond metro hub, potentially deepening capability in state capital region while question remains whether knowledge transfers beyond the metro.

signals.title: Tech Briefs: Virginia Tech adds an artificial intelligence minor to its curriculum - Cardinal News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech adding AI minor to curriculum builds deep technical capability in non-NoVA region with strong peer network effects through university system, creating foundation for distributed expertise if graduates remain regionally dispersed.
